summary: Frontend UI re-test for 3 user-reported bugs on GreekGodBerry: splash readability, splash background (3 coins instead of walking samurai), and hero cutout centering + distinct card covers. All fixes verified passing on desktop (1440x900) and mobile (375x812).

test_verifications.splash_title_readable: PASS — Title split into 'Greek' (ivory fill + black WebkitTextStroke) and 'GodBerry' (black fill + ivory WebkitTextStroke). Screenshot confirms both halves fully legible over red diagonal band; no letters merge with red band.
test_verifications.splash_three_coins_no_walking_samurai: PASS — 3 rendered inside splash-root (top-center, mid-left, mid-right). No reference to splash.webp in DOM. Filesystem confirms splash.webp deleted from /app/frontend/public/assets.
test_verifications.splash_progress_and_enter: PASS — splash-progress reached aria-valuenow=100; splash-enter button visible & clickable, navigates to Home.
test_verifications.hero_centering_desktop_1440x900: PASS — hero-cutout center X=719.99, disc center X=719.98 (dx=0.0px). Center Y match: dy=0.0px. Well within the 40px tolerance requested.
test_verifications.hero_centering_mobile_375x812: PASS — cutout cx=187.49 vs disc cx=187.50 (dx=0.0); cy match dy=0.0.
test_verifications.codex_three_paths_distinct_covers: PASS — M1 LEADERBOARDS shows podium bars with numbers 2/1/3 and '$338K WAGERED' red chip; M2 THE STORE shows samurai-coin.png with '4 REWARDS LIVE' chip; M3 STREAM GAMES shows 3x3 grid of 戦 kanji with 'Live?' black pill and 'PREDICT · WIN' chip. All 3 image wells non-empty.
test_verifications.codex_cards_navigate: PASS — /leaderboards nav works; /store nav works and renders 4 seeded rewards (STICKER PACK, VIP ROLE, SHOUTOUT, GIFT CARD).
test_verifications.age_banner_present: PASS — [data-testid=age-banner] found and rendered (dismissible I'M 18+ / DISMISS button visible).
test_verifications.regression_leaderboards: PASS — /leaderboards route loads; contains Daily/Weekly/Monthly tabs.
test_verifications.regression_store: PASS — 4 rewards visible with store-card-* and store-redeem-* testids.
test_verifications.no_module_not_found_or_asset_404s: PASS — no 'Module not found' errors in console. splash.webp not requested. Note: samurai-coin.webm / ghost.webm show net::ERR_ABORTED events — these are benign browser fetch cancellations from the splash preloader when the same video is subsequently loaded by Hero's <video> tag (the assets DO exist and stream successfully in <video> playback). Not a functional bug.
test_verifications.console_401s: Benign — /api/auth/me returns 401 for anonymous visitors as expected.

critical_code_review_comments: Splash.jsx preloadOne uses fetch() for videos which triggers a full download separately from any later <video> element consuming the file — resulting in duplicate ranged requests and the ERR_ABORTED noise. Consider preloading via a hidden <video preload='auto'> element or dropping the video preload entirely.
Hero.jsx uses hard-coded pixel disc sizes (340px / 420px) with max-w-[64vw]/[80vw] fallback. Works fine at tested breakpoints but may crowd on ~450–640px width tablets — acceptable but worth noting.
FeatureCards.jsx uses [..'戦戦戦戦戦戦戦戦戦'] to build the 3x3 grid — a plain Array.from('戦'.repeat(9)) or fixed array would be clearer.
Splash coin key={i} + fixed positions is fine, but the coin PNG is loaded from a single URL 3 times; browser will cache but the same img could be reused.
test_credentials: N/A — public pages only; localStorage keys ggb_splash_seen='1' + ggb_age_dismiss='1' used to bypass splash between navigations.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 user-reported UI bugs resolved. Splash title uses dual WebkitTextStroke technique for readability. 3 samurai-coin.png images replace prior splash.webp walking-samurai (splash.webp deleted from public/assets). Hero cutout perfectly centered on red disc + Enso ring at both 1440x900 and 375x812 (dx=dy=0). Codex cards each have distinct cover artwork. samurai-coin.webm / ghost.webm ERR_ABORTED entries in devtools are benign preloader cancellations and do not affect playback.
